evidence.title: Base Colors — Foundational Hues for Design | colorion

name: colorion
summary: Browsable library of 30,000 curated color palettes with tag filters, one-tap HEX copy and palette extraction from images.
description: A palette site for picking colors for interfaces: browse 30,000 curated palettes through 18 tags such as pastel, neon, minimal or vintage, copy HEX values in one tap, save favorites, or upload an image to detect its colors. Extra pages cover base color families and CSS snippets for loaders, toggles, tooltips and animated or gradient buttons.
contains: filters: 18 tags such as pastel, vibrant, neon, ocean, vintage, dark, light
copy HEX in one tap and save favorites
palette detection from an uploaded image
base color sheet organized by family (red, purple, green, neutral …)
extra tools: CSS loaders, toggles, tooltips, motion design, animated and gradient buttons
